applies_to: TCW320E-WMG (Ethernet) and TCW320W-WMG (Wi-Fi) per the user manual Revision R1.0; both share one fixed register map.
summary: The TCW320x-WMG is a Teracom gateway that reads up to 20 Teracom 1-Wire sensors (or DS18B20 probes) and publishes their readings on a fixed Modbus map over RS-485 RTU and Modbus TCP. Each sensor slot holds up to two float parameters; the map also has the serial settings, word-order switch and identity strings.

addressing.note: The manual prints PDU (zero-based) addresses only and says so in its addressing section; send them as printed.

source.title: TCW320E-WMG / TCW320W-WMG User Manual
source.pages: section 12 Modbus addressing and section 13 register table

notes: 32-bit values follow the Data order register (PDU 13): 1 = most significant word first (default), 2 = least significant word first. The map shows the default, ABCD.
Sensor slot n uses PDU 1000 + 10n for parameter 1 and +2 for parameter 2; the unit depends on the sensor type found in that slot.
Left out: the 32-bit float/integer test-value registers (PDU 82-95).

integration.summary: Read the sensor parameters as floats from PDU 1010 onward with function 03, over RS-485 or Modbus TCP. Lock sensor positions in the web interface so slots do not move.
integration.enable: Modbus TCP is enabled or disabled on the Modbus page of the web interface (default port 502); the RTU slave address, baud and parity are set there too and apply after saving.
quirks: Word order of every float is set by PDU 13.
The web Modbus page shows data bits and stop bits but does not let you change them (factory default 8 data, 1 stop).
Baud rate and framing written to PDU 11-12 only take effect after a power cycle.
setup: Factory network defaults: Ethernet variant 192.168.1.2; Wi-Fi variant in AP mode at 192.168.4.1.
Set RTU address/baud/parity on the Modbus page and save.
gotchas: A missing or failed sensor reads NaN.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
